title: Visual Quality System & Benchmark
source: both actual V3-45 native synthetic MP4; process after V3-45-FIX
reuse: V3-45 existing validated wire, semantic state machine & Manim process/fraction compiler
V3-45-FIX pre-validated clipped AABB process edge geometry plus physical pixel QA
V3-44-FIX 15 fps H264/AAC exact frame mux
V3-43 real-decoded-frame diagnostic principle, not its narrow model-origin evidence
objective: Share consistent host-owned visual design tokens, hierarchy, caption constraints and semantic focus across both compilers; benchmark real pixels and narration event timing rather than aesthetic success asserted by CI
design_changes: consistent Computer Modern serif font; microheader, content framing and restrained accent lines
safe area title/rail/footer and grouped semantic content layout without rewriting real claims
node captions strictly inside node with inset >=0.22 world units; edges remain AABB-clipped with V3-45-FIX clearance
visual indication must preserve math ratio, process topology, original narration and beat timing anchors
shared reusable style helper rather than two topic IDs or hard-coded video frames
automatic_gates: original fraction & process semantic JSON and narration exact unchanged
both native 1280x720 H264/AAC 15fps, exact WAV-derived frame count & four non-silent audio beats
old-to-new comparisons at same normalized beat-relative timestamps, actual decoded frame and documented SHA provenance
title/caption boxes within safe area; no text outside frame, within-node caption inset; no edge/node/cursor overlapping pixels
no flash/sustained blank frames and no unexpected visual semantic disappearance
negative controls for oversized captions, invalid safe area, design bypass and muted/synthetic video provenance

dimensions.description: Meaningful screen-space hierarchy and white-space balance
Computer Modern typography legible and not clipped or crowded
Reveals and highlights support comprehension without chaos or empty holds
Consistency of lines, corners, emphasis and transitions
Beat-relative event timing, with no fabricated word alignment

visual_quality_rubric.human_acceptance: Requires independent human reviewer; not auto-passed by author or pixel measurements

comparison.sample_policy: same frame times relative to frozen beat WAV boundaries; >=12 sampled frames per family; export matched contact sheets
comparison.metrics: occupancy/frame change/nonblank/safe areas, describe not substitute for human rating
comparison.source_count: n=2 deterministic fixtures and 1 baseline each, no statistical significance claims

limits: NO GPT-6 API request or claim genuine model authored visuals
DO NOT claim 3Blue1Brown-level quality, human-rated superiority, six-domain generality or measured learning gains
NO code execution from LLM JSON, no silent static card fallback
no main merge; PR remains Draft
